title: Standard forwarding functions
summary: `make_unique`, `make_shared` and the containers' `emplace` functions show the constructors of what they build
prose:
Each constructor is listed with the parameters the call passes its arguments
to, after the function's own ones such as the key of a map's `try_emplace`.
An aggregate lists its fields.

signatures: try_emplace(const key_type &key, ⟦int width⟧, int height) -> pair<iterator, bool>
